text:
sara: Quick owners sweep for INC-1246 RCA actions — posting current list. please confirm owners + realistic due dates by EOD Wed.

sara: Current action snapshot (from the doc):
• A1: retry/backoff fix in request router — owner: @matt — due: 2026-03-20
• A2: canary rollback + alerting play — owner: @mia — due: 2026-03-22
• A3: update runbook (playbooks + run commands) — owner: @oliver — due: 2026-03-18
• A4: add synthetic traffic test to CI (smoke) — owner: @infra-bot — due: 2026-03-19
• A5: public postmortem draft + review — owner: @lina — due: 2026-03-21

sara: I'll consolidate replies and update the tracker: https://tracker.redwood/INC-1246

matt: ack. I'll own A1. small blocker: need extra quota for a short repro cluster. pinged eng-infra channel already.

mia: I can take A2. heads-up: full canary automation pushes ETA to 03/24, but I can do a manual rollback + alerting by 03/22.

oliver: Runbook PR open: https://git.redwood/runbooks/inc-1246 -- adding checklists and commands. expecting review, ETA 03/18.

lina: I'll start the postmortem draft. Would like SRE + product eyes before public. tagging @alex for technical review.

eng-infra-bot: quota request submitted (REQ-8420) for repro cluster. Current status: pending approval. ETA ~6 hours.

alex: can review Lina's postmortem draft on Thu morning (03/19). please assign the review to me when draft is ready.

sara: matt — can you confirm the quota request covers the repro config you need? want to close that dependency in the tracker.

matt: yes, request includes the extra nodes and ephemeral GPUs I listed. if eng-infra takes longer I'll fallback to a local repro with sampling but will extend A1 ETA by 1 day.

jess: (from eng-infra) i'll own follow-up for REQ-8420 and update the tracker when approved. putting this on my board for today.

sara: perfect. jess, can you add the approval timestamp to the tracker once done? helps us shift A1 if needed.

jess: yep, will update. also note: infra might need a quick config tweak to enable ephemeral GPU quotas; i'll include step-by-step in the approval notes.

mia: re A2 — if we go manual rollback path, who owns the runbook update to reflect manual steps? oliver or me?

oliver: I can add a small section in the runbook for manual rollback now, will PR that by EOD.

lina: timeline ask — once I have Alex's review, can PM/Product do a quick read for customer-facing wording?

product: happy to review the public-facing section after Alex's technical review. aim for 24h turnaround.

sara: summary: owners confirmed: A1 @matt (jess infra support), A2 @mia (manual: 03/22, full automation: 03/24), A3 @oliver (03/18), A4 @infra-bot / eng-infra (03/19), A5 @lina (draft -> @alex -> @product, final 03/21). I'll update the tracker and ping again if any dates slip.

matt: ack. if quota is delayed i'll post an explicit ETA change.

jess: REQ-8420 approved at 11:42 PST, updated tracker.

sara: thanks — closing this sweep. if anyone needs to reassign, reply here with new owner + brief reason. :thumbsup:
